device.name: LI-COR Odyssey Classic 9120 infrared imager (CGI over HTTP)

facts.text: The Odyssey Classic is a LI-COR model 9120 infrared imaging system operated by a FastAPI control app over the instrument's embedded HTTP CGI interface
The upstream transport is an aiohttp client with Basic Auth for an Apache/mod_perl CGI interface reverse-engineered from the browser
The scan setup form posts to /scanapp/scan/nonjava/configure.pl and scan commands go to command.pl?action=start|stop|pause|cancel
configure.pl returns a 302 redirect to the initializing.pl countdown, and configure_scan follows the redirect to start hardware initialization
The full seven-step initializing.pl countdown must be polled before start because skipping it skips motor and laser warm-up
start_scan, stop_scan, pause_scan and cancel_scan send command.pl actions start, stop, pause and cancel; an error page or 'not configured' is raised
The status page returns the scanner state, current user, percent complete, time remaining and lid status
The status parser extracts the lid status from the status page
The device card declares a lid interlock
stop_from_status posts action=Stop to the status page, is the documented way to release a paused or stuck scanner without the scan console, and returns the response text without checking it
After command.pl stop, stop_and_save polls the status page until the state reads idle or stopped and raises when that takes longer than _STOP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SEC
_STOP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SEC is 15.0
OdysseyDriver.stop closes the HTTP session; it is not a scanner stop
get_jpeg_preview fetches a JPEG preview the instrument renders server-side with the requested contrast, channels and background
download_tiff downloads one raw TIFF channel (700 or 800) from /scan/image/<name>-<channel>.tif
get_scan_progress reads the imaging info panel and returns dimensions, file size and time left
get_instrument_info fetches the instrument information page (serial number, software version)
The device card records 700 nm and 800 nm solid-state diode lasers with 80 mW peak power each

The device card records scan resolutions 21, 42, 84, 169 and 337 um, quality levels lowest through highest, an intensity range of 0.5 to 10.0 in 0.5 steps, a 25 x 25 cm scan area and a focus offset range of 0.0 to 4.0 mm
The canonical instrument states are Idle, Configured, Initializing, Scanning, Paused, Stopped, Completed and Failed, and unrecognized status text is mapped to Idle
The upstream ships in-memory simulated scan, image and status backends
Credentials are read from ODYSSEY_USER and ODYSSEY_PASS
When host is None, from_env reads ODYSSEY_HOST

safe_state.description: the status-page Stop command is sent (POST bounded to two seconds) and the stop holds only when a fresh status read then reports Idle or Stopped, the states the upstream's stop_and_save waits for; that wait may last up to 15 s upstream, so an attempt can be reported unreached and is retried; any other state, a timeout or an error is a failed safe state; lid, lasers and queued firmware work are not confirmed
